facets.description: getShortcut() javadoc suggests 3-letter shortcuts, but getTokenContextFromTokenId requires a 6-char context (2-char grant shortcut), so tokens from a conforming custom grant can't be decoded.
Shortcut length is never checked (not in encodeTokenId and not in DefaultTokenContextEncoderProviderFactory.postInit), so token ids that can't be decoded still get created.
Ids that contain a colon but have a prefix that isn't 6 chars throw IllegalArgumentException instead of falling back to UNKNOWN like ids without a colon.
